success: Weapons slide free, and the air goes tight.
A heartbeat of silence, then everyone moves at once.
Someone shouts a warning. It is already too late for words.
Eyes lock, muscles tense: this is going to be a fight.
The first steps scrape the ground as both sides close in.
Breath quickens, hands find hilts and spell focuses.
There is no turning back now.
The noise fades, and only heavy breathing remains.
Silence settles over the field, save for the drip of something best not examined.
Hands still shaking, the survivors lower their weapons.
The dust settles. It is over, for now.
Someone lets out a long, trembling breath.
The adrenaline ebbs, and every bruise starts to ache.
For a moment no one speaks; then the questions begin.
The echoes die away, and the world feels very quiet.
